Definition: of Latin origin; third; Tertius, a Christian:--Tertius.
BiblicalUsage: Tertius is the Christian who wrote down Paul's letter to the Romans at Paul's dictation. In Romans 16:22, I Tertius, who wrote this epistle.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Tertius shows me God keeps His promises across generations, even through flawed families.
